  • 🧮 Purchasing invoice calculation function: A function that receives the original price of the item and the discount percentage and returns to us the final approved and discounted price.

💻 Starter Code Block - Purchasing invoice calculation function:

stations.title: Station 6: OOP Encapsulation & Properties
stations.desc: Protecting internal object data from random or malicious modification using software access controls such as security encapsulation.
stations.story:

🎯 Key Points Covered in this Session:

  • 💰 Protecting the customer's bank balance: Preventing direct modification of the customer’s bank balance and forcing the process to pass through smart and strict verification functions.

💻 Starter Code Block - Protecting the customer's bank balance:

class BankAccount {
    private $balance = 0;
    public function deposit($amount) {
        if ($amount > 0) { $this->balance += $amount; }
    }
    public function getBalance() { return $this->balance; }
}
